3558-5006-8170-8250.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-5006-8170-8250.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat.

240-997-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

2921-3478-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5434-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5434-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

7-1824-2530-7359.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
7-1824-2530-7359.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-1824-2530-7359.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Tablet of the Guilds triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2457-4289-6705-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

856-2558-6748-6797.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-2558-6748-6797.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

2103-6122-6991.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Donnie & April by paying its mana cost.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Donnie & April from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
2103-6122-6991.notes: If you cast Donnie & April from the command zone to start, you must be able to pay for commander tax that first turn.

141-2562-5256.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

2773-5641-6919.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2773-5641-6919.notablePrerequisites: You control a static effect that boosts the power of creatures and/or creature tokens you control by at least 1.
2773-5641-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Basking Broodscale.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage to Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1182-2835-5220.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Fecundity.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Stonecoil Serpent from your library.
Repeat.

2421-3705-5231-6633.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2073-6248-6808.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 13 or higher.
You control a creature with power 2 or greater.
2073-6248-6808.description:
Activate The Last Ride's crew ability by tapping a creature with power 2 or greater, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
The Last Ride dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Salvaging Station and Phenomenon Investigators.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1669-5478-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
1669-5478-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

2292-4484-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
2292-4484-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

290-1987-3094.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting any two permanents.
Holding priority, activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Ghostly Flicker, with the copy targeting Dreamstone Hedron and Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Dreamstone Hedron and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-5437-5742-5743.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

573-1479-1817.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-1817.description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell, with the copy not being legendary.
Resolve both Kodama of the East Tree spells.
Play Gruul Turf.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 7.

500-4823-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-4823-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Timeless Witness and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Timeless Witness tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

643-1447-4050.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Glory's Rise, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, then returning all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1821-3000.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
643-1821-3000.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
When the creature entes the battlefield as a Phyrexian due to Maskwood Nexus, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat step 2.
